notes.title: Add new content (Release in August)
notes.notes:
Added
- treasure objects. It will appear when unit is near
- add new start settings: quantity of spawned enemies, animals
Fixed
- Enemies didnt patrol on "Simple map"
- Unit inside a tower was looking at enemy by wrong angle
- walls could spawn everywhere

notes.title: Large fixed update
notes.notes:
Added:
- edit a amount of start units and animals
- spots on ground landscape
Fixed:
- error when destroyed tree try to drop resources
- unit lost defence target after attack
- patrol of enemies didnt attack everybody during moving
- error after fast buying a extra mining
- flag of upgraded tower looks isnt correct
- unit cant detect predator animals
- player cant interact with object if it is near water
- worker cant interact with builds if UI of build is open
- tower is shooting by ugly trajectory
- error if selected unit is dead
- units inside build is stay instead sit
- checking obstacle is correct now

notes.title: Switch a sub genre. Large update
notes.notes:
Changed a maps from RTS to Cozy RTS style. 
- Everybody requares food. 
- Every NPC will search food (meat or plantfood depend from type of NPC) for increase health. 
- Enemy tribes will try to conquer your island. Its depend how much player have units.
- Player can buy tech or extra resources for mining
- Player can edit start free resources before new game
Fixed:
- accuracy of shootable constructions
- catapult dont take more 1 bullet now
- player cant to create several blouprint objects (except walls)
- bug when unit send to storage a carry resources after opened storage menu
- didnt appear farm menu sometimes
- builds didnt remove all environment inside self after placement
- mine UI show resources for mine and gathering now
